color.note: One dark theme: ink grounds, amber (gold-*) as the primary accent, forged gold (forge-*) as the secondary, blood crimson, parchment and bone text, cold steel, patina. Components read the semantic aliases.

tokens.name: ink-800
tokens.usage: Inset fields through `surface-inset`: Input, Select, unchecked Checkbox and Switch; the emblem's fill.
